content_sections.heading: UAS Dharwad Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. ಡೀನ್(ಕೃಷಿ)/ಕೃಮಹ/ 601-ಬಿ /2026-27 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download UAS Dharwad notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Masters Degree in Agronomy with NET & One NAAS rated Research Paper (or an equivalent impact factor) - Rs. 40,000/-; OR Doctoral Degree in Agronomy with NET or Two Research Papers with NAAS rating not less than 4 (or an equivalent impact factor) - Rs. 45,000/-; Master's degree in Agronomy with at least 55% (traditional), 60% (trimester) or 70% (semester system) marks or equivalent grade; 5% relaxation as per No. 2.4 of guidelines No. R/R1G/R006/2022-23 dated 15.03.2023; NET by UGC/ICAR/CSIR or similar UGC-accredited test like SLET/SET; Ph.D. holders as per UGC Regulations 2009 or 2016 exempted from NET/SLET/SET Other conditions: Candidates must attend the interview at their own cost University reserves the right to cancel the recruitment at any time Candidates must bring original documents for verification

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Temporary appointment for a period not exceeding 179 days Appointment may be terminated at any time without giving any reason Temporary appointment gives no claim of any kind to direct appointment in the Agricultural University

content_sections.heading: How Will UAS Dharwad Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Walk-in interview Selection by walk-in interview

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Two copies of the filled application form (Annexure) Photographs All original documents related to qualification Two attested copies of the documents

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for UAS Dharwad Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill in your details in two copies of the application form given in the annexure of the notice. Attach photographs to the form. Appear at the Office of the Dean (Agri), College of Agriculture, Hanumanamatti at 10.00 AM on 01.12.2026. Bring all original documents related to qualification and two attested copies of them. Do not send the application in advance under any circumstances.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Applications must not be sent in advance under any circumstances Roster point of the post: GM(W) Post is for teaching Agronomy to B.Sc.(Agri) students (account head 2036/310)
